### Imports

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(stringr) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(dplyr) 
library(lme4) 
library(ggplot2) 
library(lmtest) 

set.seed(13)
```

### Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv('../Data/level2_trial_data.csv',  na.strings=c("","NA"))  
df$DEPTH <- relevel(factor(df$DEPTH), ref='3')
df$HAS_X <- as.numeric(df$NUM_X > 0)

tab <- table(df$DEPTH, df$HAS_X)
tab <- t(apply(tab,1, function(x) x/sum(x)))

round(tab[,2],3)
```

### Hypothesis

Depth has an effect such that a new category (X) will appear more often in the 2-level than in the 3-level condition.

### Frequentist

```{r}
m1 <- glmer(HAS_X ~ 1 + DEPTH + (1|P_ID) + (1|STIMULI),
            family = binomial,
            data = df)

m1.1 <- glmer(HAS_X ~ 1 + DEPTH + (1|POOL/P_ID) + (1|STIMULI),
            family = binomial,
            data = df)

lrtest(m1, m1.1)

```

```{r}
m0 <- glmer(HAS_X ~ 1 + (1|P_ID)  + (1|STIMULI),
            family = binomial,
            data = df)
lrtest(m0, m1)
round(fixef(m1), 2)
round(confint(m1, parm='DEPTH2', method='Wald'), 2)
```

```{r}
sim_df <- read.csv('../Data/sim_level2_trial_data.csv',  na.strings=c("","NA"))  

sim_df$DEPTH <- relevel(factor(sim_df$DEPTH), ref='3')
sim_df$HAS_X <- as.numeric(sim_df$NUM_X > 0)


tab <- table(sim_df$DEPTH, sim_df$HAS_X)
tab <- t(apply(tab,1, function(x) x/sum(x)))

round(tab[,2],3)
```

```{r}
m1 <- glm(HAS_X ~ 1 + DEPTH,
            family = binomial,
            data = sim_df)

m0 <- glm(HAS_X ~ 1,
            family = binomial,
            data = sim_df)
lrtest(m0, m1)

round(coef(m1)["DEPTH2"], 2)
round(confint(m1, parm='DEPTH2', method='Wald'), 2)
```
